text: Rin - son Jonah starts reception Weds. she's v nervous, he's not. text her Weds pm to ask how drop off went

Miriam & Obi got the flat on Carlton Rd!! moving in a fortnight, Sat the 8th. offered van - Obi's been stressing abt the survey but it came back clean. their old landlord being difficult re deposit. Miriam says they'll need help w/ the piano, 3rd floor, no lift. I said yes obvs. ask Gareth if he's free that Sat too
Yuki's cat Biscuit - kidney thing, vet again tomorrow morning @ 9. she's in bits
Lena graduating Fri at 2pm, Durham. mum & nan going. card + something small - she mentioned wanting a decent fountain pen
call Anan re puppy?? collecting her Sunday, cockapoo, name tbc
Heather - viewing x2 this wknd, Leith + Stockbridge. hates the commute from Fife. ask Mon how they went
bins Tues not Weds this wk (bank hol)
Rory - GCSE mocks start next Mon. stressed abt maths esp. his dad's away for work all fortnight so Heather doing it solo. wish him luck sun night

Gareth & Imani moving to Bristol - offer accepted, completion end of Nov. he's sorted a transfer w/ his firm, she's still job hunting. their twins start new school Jan. Imani said the school visits went well, the girls liked the one w/ the swimming pool. Gareth's mum not happy abt them going so far. leaving bbq maybe 2nd wk of Nov, tbc
Elijah's dog Pepper turns 1 Thurs lol. he's doing a 'party'. dog treats from that place on Mill St?
Jonah - Dr Nowak said results Fri. no news yet. don't push
Lorenzo passed driving test 1st go!! this morning. congrats msg
Duc - kid's first day @ nursery tomorrow. Duc more nervous than the kid tbh
Marcus moving to Leeds next month for the new job @ Arup. leaving do Thurs 7pm, Crown. I'm driving
Dana - hamster died. kids devastated. her youngest Milan keeps asking where it went
Kalani rang - flat fell thru, buyer pulled out last night. back to square one. check in w/ her in a few days
Ana (Ana-banana per her sister lol) - just got into Edinburgh for vet med!! starts Sept. whole family over the moon
Mohammed's daughter Imani graduated Weds - nursing, first class. he showed me like 40 photos. send congrats to Imani via him
Milan - new kitten, Mochi. black w/ white socks. allergic partner tho, so... we'll see
Ilse - housewarming Sat from 6, new place in Clapham. bring wine, she doesn't eat meat so no salami
Siddharth's mum - hip op next Tues morning. he's taking the wk off to look after her. text him Tues eve
Teresa & Dmitri - their 2 starting secondary next wk, same school. Teresa dreading the uniform bill

Nasser: dog Rocky has to have his leg op Friday at 8am, collecting him Sat. Nasser v anxious, Rocky is 12. ring him Fri afternoon. vet thinks 70/30 he'll be fine but at his age who knows. Nasser's kids don't know yet how serious it is. said I'd take the boys to the park Sat morning to keep them busy
Dalia moving back to Joburg in Jan!! leaving party was meant to be Sat but cancelled, her dad's not well. she's flying out early instead, Weds
Thabo - son Obi's exams start tomorrow, A levels. Thabo says he's barely revising, all FIFA
Jin got the keys today! 2 bed in Walthamstow. move in this Sat, then painting Sun. offered to help w/ boxes

Sofia (Sof) - lab puppy arriving next Sat, 'Bramble'. already bought 3 beds lol. she asked abt puppy classes near us - find a link and send it. she's working from home Mon-Weds for the first fortnight to settle her in. Marcus not keen on the dog sleeping upstairs, compromise = crate on the landing
Joy's grandson Rory - first day @ uni Mon, Manchester. she's knitted him a scarf in his halls colours
viewing 14 Ashgrove Tues at half 5. take tape measure. ask abt parking
Rin & her husband Lorenzo - 10th anniv in a fortnight, Fri 21st. thinking Lake District. she wants a surprise but 'not a big one'
Miriam - cat Pickles missing since Sunday night. posters up. check if she's heard anything tomorrow
Yuki - piano exam grade 5, Thurs at 4. said she'd be fine but she was shaking talking abt it. text good luck Thurs morning
Lena's brother Siddharth got into the army. passing out parade sometime in spring
Anan - puppy update: chewed the sofa, wee everywhere, no sleep. he's knackered. she's cute tho

Heather's mum moving into a care home next Weds. Heather feeling guilty abt it, not sleeping much. I said I'd drop round w/ dinner Thurs. maybe bring flowers too. her brother Rory (not that Rory) won't help, lives in Dubai. care home is the one nr Inverleith, she says the staff are lovely
Rory got a 7 in maths mock!! (after all that). Heather proud
Gareth (Gaz) - running Bristol half Sun 6th, raising £ for the vets that saved their dog. sponsor him
Elijah - PhD viva Mon 10am. not nervous he says. ask how it went Mon eve
Imani - interview @ Bristol Uni next Thurs. remind her to send the portfolio Weds
Jonah - results back, all clear 🎉. he & partner off to Lisbon next wk to celebrate
Lorenzo's sister Sofia getting married in Sicily next June. he's best man (panicking abt the speech)
Duc & his wife Ana - baby no. 2 due in March! didn't know. she's been really sick, first trimester rough
must sort council tax for new flat by Friday. also redirect post
Marcus - first wk at Arup done. said Leeds is grim in the rain but team's great. likes the climbing wall nr his flat
Obi - ginger cat Sergeant has diabetes, injections 2x a day now. Obi hates needles so Miriam doing it
Dana's oldest, Joy, sitting 11+ Sat morning. Dana more stressed than Joy. message Sat lunchtime to see how it went
Kalani - new buyer! exchange next Fri, moving Tues after. said she'll believe it when it's done
Ana - vegan now, since summer. loves bouldering. hates coriander

Mohammed - wife Teresa's 50th Sat week. surprise meal @ Dishoom, 7.30. he's asked me to keep it quiet + bring the photo book. Teresa loves gin + anything Liberty print. he's getting her a necklace; I'll chip in for flowers w/ Lena
Milan's partner Dalia - allergy fine actually. kitten staying. Mochi already rules the flat
Ilse got the promotion - head of design from Jan. she's moving teams too, starts new role after Xmas break. send something nice
Siddharth's mum home now, op went well. he's back at work Mon. check in on her end of wk
Teresa - dog Dex put to sleep yesterday. 14 yrs. she couldn't talk much. card tomorrow

Dmitri's dad flying in from Riga Thurs evening for 3 wks. first time seeing the new house. Dmitri says it's going to be 'intense'. he's taking him to Edinburgh for a long weekend the 2nd wk, then the in-laws Sunday lunch, then Dad flies home the 3rd at 6am. Dmitri hasn't told his dad abt the job change yet
Nasser - Rocky home, op went fine, cone of shame. Nasser relieved
Thabo's wife Heather - promoted to head teacher, starts after half term. big deal for her

Jin - painting done, housewarming probably next month. wants a big monstera for the living room (gift idea). they'd been together 6 yrs. she's thinking abt moving back to Lisbon in the spring, maybe sooner. her mum flying over this wknd to stay w/ her. text her next wk
Sofia & Marcus split. she's keeping the flat + Bramble. she seemed ok but quiet
Joy - knee bad again, physio Mon at 11. can't walk the dog so her neighbour helping. pop round w/ shopping Weds

Long call w/ Rin tonight. Jonah settling in at school fine now - first wk was tears every morning, now he runs in. she's going back to work 3 days a wk from Mon, nervous abt it, been off 4 yrs. also her mum moving in w/ them next month after the fall. lot on. msg her Mon eve re first day back
